entities.summary: Maria Zankovetska Theatre is a drama theatre in the centre of Lviv, Ukraine, at the intersection of Lesya Ukrayinka Street and Prospekt Svobody. The building was erected in the mid 19th century, when it was the home of the Galician parliament, and was used as a theatre stage throughout the period until World War I.
